purpose: TapTap 游戏内登录失败重试页 UI 设计稿；不接入运行代码

viewport.note: 设计安全边距；实现时读取真实设备安全区，不硬编码机型

typography.display: 现有中文宋体／衬线标题，暗金

layout.description: 山谷全屏背景，居中窄幅标题和单张登录失败面板；内容与按钮共用安全区中轴。
layout.touchTarget: 后续接入时至少48逻辑像素；本稿的44为可见按钮高度

states.shown: 登录失败、需要手动重试
states.normalStart: 沿用旅途加载画面，不显示本页
states.foregroundValid: 静默校验，保留游戏和菜单，不显示本页
states.retry: 禁用重复触发并显示连接中，成功后回到原流程

reviewBeforeGeneration.retained: 现有山谷、宋体标题、暗金双层框、深青切角按钮。
reviewBeforeGeneration.revised: 去掉把版本号放在登录标题、大面积装饰和额外操作的方案；只保留状态、行动、进度保留说明。
reviewBeforeGeneration.constraints: 不新增游客、云存档、换账号、跳过登录或点空白关闭能力。

generation.operation: Existing project landscape as base plus approved menu/frame style references; new UI concept generated in one call

artReview.status: assistant visual inspection passed; awaiting user design review
artReview.inspected: Full generated output displayed by image_gen
artReview.text: All seven requested text strings are legible and correct, including 剑与火、破晓之战、TapTap 登录、暂时无法连接 TapTap、请检查网络后重试、重试登录、本地进度已保留。
artReview.style: Natural spring valley retained; restrained rounded double gold panel border; warm serif title and deep teal chamfered primary action match existing UI direction.
artReview.composition: Single centered failure/retry panel, scenery visible around it, one action; no guest/account/cloud-save controls added.
limitations: Actual generated canvas is 1844×853, close to the 844:390 design aspect; it is not a 2532×1170 export.
